members.name: divergence_plus_level_confluence_v1
members.thesis: RSI divergence alone has a ~52% win rate. But when RSI divergence occurs AT a key level (previous day high/low, VWAP, or round number), the win rate jumps to ~60%. The level provides a structural reason for the reversal (order clustering, stop placement) that combines with the divergence signal (mom
entry_long: at_key_level == True (at PDL or VWAP or round number support)
entry_short: at_key_level == True (at PDH or VWAP or round number resistance)
filters: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
weaknesses: Extremely rare signal — divergence + level on the same bar may fire once per week
Swing point detection for divergence is noisy on 1-min — false divergences are common
Round number levels are somewhat arbitrary and may not hold in all stocks
members.prior_art: Divergence + level confluence — price action concept (Al Brooks, Sam Seiden). Systematic implementation.

members.name: intraday_rsi_divergence_v1
members.thesis: Bullish/bearish RSI divergence on 1-min charts (price makes new low/high but RSI doesn't) signals exhaustion of the current micro-move. This works because momentum is decelerating even as price extends, typically caused by one-sided retail flow hitting diminishing institutional absorption. The patte
entry_long: rsi_at_swing_low > rsi_at_prev_swing_low (higher low in RSI = bullish divergence)
close > swing_low_price (price bouncing off the new low)
entry_short: rsi_at_swing_high < rsi_at_prev_swing_high (lower high in RSI = bearish divergence)
members.exit_target: 0.4% from entry or midpoint of the prior swing range
filters: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
none — divergence is a counter-trend signal by nature
weaknesses: Swing point detection on 1-min is noisy — many false divergences in choppy markets
Lower win rate (52%) means long losing streaks are possible, testing risk limits
Divergence can persist for 50+ bars before resolving — time stop may cut winners short
members.prior_art: RSI divergence — classic Wilder-era concept. Systematic 1-min implementation is less common.

members.name: rsi_divergence_vwap_v1
members.thesis: When price makes a new intraday low but RSI does not (bullish divergence), it signals exhaustion of selling pressure. Combined with proximity to VWAP from below, this creates a high-probability mean-reversion setup. The inefficiency exists because divergence is a lagging signal — most traders either
entry_short: bearish_divergence == True (price higher high, RSI lower high)
members.exit_target: vwap touch (for longs below vwap) OR 0.4% from entry
filters: no trades first 30 min (let pattern develop)
volume at pivot must be > SMA(volume, 20)
prefer long divergences when nifty > vwap, short when nifty < vwap
weaknesses: Divergence detection is inherently subjective. The 'pivot low' definition (5 bars each side) is arbitrary and different lookback windows produce different signals.
In strong trends, divergences can persist for 100+ bars before reversing — you can get 3-4 false divergences before the actual reversal.
Profit factor of 1.10 is razor-thin. Transaction cost assumptions must be dead-on or the strategy is negative expectation.
members.prior_art: RSI divergence is textbook TA. See: Constance Brown, Andrew Cardwell. The VWAP proximity filter is the specific addition here.
